mapper.select: SELECT * FROM direct_sale ORDER BY seq DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO direct_sale (seq, name, description, product_name, image_url, price, created_at, seller_seq, category_seq, trade_location_seq) VALUES (direct_sale_seq.nextval, #{name}, #{description, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{productName}, #{imageUrl, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{price}, SYSDATE, #{sellerSeq}, #{categorySeq}, #{tradeLocationSeq, jdbcType=BIGINT})
mapper.select: SELECT ds.seq, ds.name, ds.product_name AS productName, ds.price, ds.image_url AS imageUrl, ds.status, tl.dong, tl.lat, tl.lng, m.name AS sellerName, ds.created_at AS createdAt FROM direct_sale ds JOIN member m ON ds.seller_seq = m.seq LEFT JOIN trade_location tl ON ds.trade_location_seq = tl.seq ORDER BY ds.seq DESC
